title: Chapter 1380
text:
The battle areas of the Beyond Grade As were scattered all over the battlefield, and they were engaged in a bloody battle. The individual strengths of both sides fell one after another, and the battle between the fleets of both sides was also intense. The World Tree Army, which was continuously supported by the Tree King Halo, continued to advance. Although the three Universal Civilizations were constantly providing reinforcements, the defensive line was still slowly but firmly retreating.

As the battlefield situation of the fleets kept changing, the battle areas of the Beyond Grade As also changed time and time again.

Ames moved through the starry sky, controlling her force field to harass the enemy or help her comrades. Her dress was stained with blood.

In the battle area she was in, there were more than ten Beyond Grade As fighting in a team battle. The association members and the direct descendants worked together to fight the enemy and had the upper hand.

The Force Field Esper Ability had the all-purpose characteristic of being able to attack and defend. Ames mainly played a control role on the battlefield, and occasionally, she would condense her force field or drag a battleship to launch an attack. The damage was not low either.

She extended her hand and released the Dragon's Gaze on a Holy Tree Emissary. Ames quickly scanned the battlefield and realized that the battlefield of Herberlon, Fortitude Tree King, Han Xiao, and Heart Tree King had already moved very far away. The layers of battleships on the battlefield almost covered their figures. She could only see the occasional energy light that burst out, which was far more intense than here.

"Looks like he won't be able to kill the Tree King so quickly …"

Ames frowned slightly and retracted her gaze. Her body flashed past a condensed photon beam, and she raised her hand to sweep out a light green shockwave as a counterattack.

In the blink of an eye, she looked at the battlefield and saw that the enemy had revealed a temporary flaw. Ames was about to call for her teammates to cooperate and create time for her to accumulate power, but at this moment, the other party threw a wave of focused fire at her. The few association members who were supposed to block in front dodged, and she had no choice but to stop the thought of accumulating power and dodge helplessly.

"This won't do. We can't kill the enemy."

Ames glanced at the association members and shook her head.

Although they had always had the upper hand, they had not been able to cause much effective damage to the enemy. Every time they wanted to take a step forward, the World Tree experts would become more and more fearless. However, the comrades of the association members would cower because of this, not wanting to get injured and take the hit head-on, causing them to lose the opportunity to expand their advantage time and time again.

The temporary loss of the healer had a huge impact on the Beyond Grade A battle. Most of the association members no longer had the mentality to risk their lives like last time, and they were unwilling to get injured. Their combat style suddenly became conservative, and the World Tree experts became more and more ferocious.

Ames heard from the channel that many association members were dissatisfied with Han Xiao's attack plan this time. At the beginning, the plan was to quickly get rid of the Tree King to reduce the disadvantage of the head-on battle, but now, both sides were in a stalemate. Black Star had not completed his goal, and Aurora had been temporarily knocked out, causing many Beyond Grade As to be sacrificed. In their eyes, the plan had failed, and they would only lose money.

Furthermore, after fighting for so long, the main battlefield was already in a precarious situation. Even if they killed the Tree King now, they might not be able to reverse the situation. Therefore, in the eyes of many association members, the sacrifice of this attack plan was meaningless. Instead, many people lost the one-time opportunity to revive in the Sanctum, so they were quite resentful.

The members of the Beyond Grade A Association were all prepared for the worst. Currently, they still believed that the Sanctum Revival could only be used once, and they did not take Han Xiao's words of 'convincing' the revivors seriously.

Many people already had the intention to retreat, but they could not leave the battle for the time being. They could only protect themselves and were not willing to pay the price to kill their opponents. This conservative mentality affected their combat strength, and Ames had no choice but to cooperate with her teammates. She had no intention of charging into the enemy's group alone.

At this moment, one of the Holy Tree Emissaries suddenly paused, as if the damage had reached its limit. His body stiffened, revealing an obvious flaw.

"Chance!"

Ames and her teammates immediately changed their target and focused all their attacks on this person. All kinds of abilities shattered the defensive shield that the other party had hastily constructed and landed on his body. Blood splattered everywhere, instantly severely injuring him.

Just as everyone was about to take the opportunity to chase after and kill an enemy, the other World Tree experts suddenly erupted with their full strength, bringing with them abundant energy as they blasted toward the front of this heavily injured teammate, trying to force them to retreat like the previous few times.

Facing the powerful attacks, the association members hesitated and retreated. They did not face them head-on. It was not that they could not withstand the attacks, but they were not willing to. They would rather give up this opportunity than get injured.

Seeing this, Ames was a little helpless. This had already happened several times. Due to the retreat of the association members, they had missed many opportunities.

However, at this moment, a determined voice suddenly sounded in the channel.

"Cover me!"

One of the direct descendants' teammates suddenly charged forward instead of retreating, facing this wave of attacks head-on. The scene was like a surfer charging toward a tsunami. The shield on his body was instantly torn apart by the combined attacks of multiple Beyond Grade As, and wounds appeared on his body.

Everyone was shocked. They did not have the time to think about anything else and quickly stopped, using long-range attacks to cover this teammate.

He ignored the injuries on his body and forcefully passed through the attack wave, charging resolutely and decisively toward the heavily injured World Tree expert. His Pugilist flames were all condensed on his body, completely ignoring the enemy teammates who were rushing over.

Bang!

The two figures collided. Seeing that the enemy was charging over, the heavily injured World Tree Beyond Grade A activated self-destruction without hesitation.

Ames and the others only had time to see this direct Beyond Grade A's figure without any intention of retreating. The next moment, their vision was covered by a vast expanse of white.

Boom!

A strong light burst forth, and a huge energy cluster rose. Before the light disappeared, the surrounding World Tree experts were still releasing attacks toward the self-destruction area.

Everyone hurriedly retreated a distance away. After the energy of the explosion was released, they looked at the area again. There were only incomplete corpses left.

"… He's gone."

Everyone had complicated expressions.

The direct Beyond Grade As who died in battle were not Revivors. They knew that there was only one chance for the Sanctum Revival, but they still sacrificed their lives without hesitation in order to seize the opportunity. This was something that they would never be able to do. These direct members who served the civilization had a purer attitude toward this war than they did. They were not afraid of death.

Ames shook her head. She knew that she was not that great, and she did not want to be great.

…

Time quickly passed in the intense battle.

In the battlefield filled with countless mechanical fragments, Han Xiao and Heart Tree King had been fighting for a long time. Both sides had consumed a certain amount of energy.

In comparison, Heart Tree King's consumption was greater. This was not only because of Han Xiao's Energy Rank suppression, but also because of his class.

After all, mental attacks were ineffective against mechanical soldiers, and Han Xiao's main body was not afraid of his mental attacks. Only psychic attacks with mediocre physical attacks could be effective. This meant that Heart Tree King was destined to be at a disadvantage when facing Han Xiao.

The green light on Heart Tree King's body dimmed a lot, and more than half of the World Tree Roots brought about by his transformation had been destroyed. His condition was far worse than before the battle, and his movements were slightly sluggish.

After using psychokinesis to block the firepower of another mechanical army, Heart Tree King once again sent a mental message to Han Xiao and said calmly, "Don't worry.

"Do you see that? Your defeat is set. Even if you kill me, you won't be able to salvage the situation."

Hearing this, Han Xiao looked at the battle situation and could not help but cluck his tongue.

The World Tree Army in this war zone continued to advance. They had already broken through the defense zone and killed their way through a few battle lines, forming an irreversible situation. There was at least an eighty to ninety percent chance of breaking through the interception circle and turning this place into a breakthrough point for the entire battle. In a war of hundreds of billions, the victory of high-level combatants could no longer reverse this situation.

"When we reach your territory, the mother tree will enjoy your world inch by inch. You won't have any chance. Do you want to reconsider my previous suggestion?" Heart Tree King continued to bewitch him.

Han Xiao did not say anything. He turned around and slashed at him as a response.

Heart Tree King hurriedly dodged, but he was still grazed by the psionic energy. The psychic barrier shattered, and another World Tree Root broke.

"Hehe, looks like you're very determined …"

Heart Tree King smiled on the surface, but his heart was filled with fear. He already had the intention to retreat.

After this round of battle, he realized that he really could not beat this outsider. Just the large number of powerful Apostle Weapons was enough to make him suffer, and the injuries in his body were burning.

If this continues, I'm afraid I'll really die here. The other Beyond Grade As will probably be free soon. It's time to retreat …

Heart Tree King thought to himself.

Many of the World Tree experts had already been sacrificed because the other party had more Beyond Grade As present. Heart Tree King knew that the casualties on his side would only snowball. Before long, other Beyond Grade As would come to help this outsider deal with him. At that time, it would be difficult for him to leave.

Although he was prepared to die here when he set off, the exchange tactic had already taken effect. There was no need to continue fighting here. It was best if he could save his life.

After making up his mind, Heart Tree King stopped bombarding him with chat streams and immediately changed his strategy. He tried to break out of the encirclement and retreat, trying to shake off the encirclement and entanglement of Han Xiao's mechanical army and return to the fleet to receive protection.

Sensing the change in Heart Tree King's movements, Han Xiao's eyes flickered.

"He finally wants to run. It seems like he's exhausted enough. We can carry out the plan!"

Han Xiao immediately gave a direct order to Zhan Dou Zhi Neng. The mechanical army immediately chased after him and guided Heart Tree King's movements by adjusting the weakness of the encirclement.

At the same time, he took the initiative to send a message to Heart Tree King.

"You'll die here today!"

This time, it was Heart Tree King who turned a deaf ear. He focused on avoiding the focus fire of the mechanical army and quickly found a weakness to break out of the encirclement.

After Han Xiao shouted, he stared at the changes in the formation. Seeing that Heart Tree King was slowly forced to a suitable position, Mechanical Force flashed all over his body.

Buzz!

A Lord's Avatar wrapped in Mechanical Force suddenly shot out from the Mechanical Deity and flew toward Heart Tree King, emitting the shocking energy of a peak Beyond Grade A Super.

Sensing the incoming danger, Heart Tree King suddenly turned his head, condensed his psychic power, and swept it at the Lord's Avatar. If he hit it, he would definitely be able to send it flying.

However, at this moment, a golden energy suddenly gushed out from the Lord's Avatar's body. It was as though he had turned into an indomitable golden chariot that instantly crushed the psychic power. He was not affected at all and locked onto Heart Tree King as he charged forward. His speed seemed to be endless.

"Hmm?"

Heart Tree King was a little surprised. He controlled the last World Tree Root to smash it over, intending to stop it. However, it was knocked away by the Lord's Avatar, and it could not even slow it down.

Seeing this, Han Xiao, who was still inside the Mechanical Deity, could not help but clench his fists. His palms were sweating.

His main body was right in front of him, but he had used Lord's Descent. Naturally, it was to capture Heart Tree King alive. For this, he did not hesitate to activate two Character Summon Cards — Yin Ying's (Comet Gliding) and Oulou's (Golden Treasure Ship-Ram)!

The former gave him endless acceleration, while the latter gave him an uncontrollable Super Armor state during the charging process!

Success or failure depended on this. Han Xiao was betting that Heart Tree King would not self-destruct before he got close!

Heart Tree King's warning signs became more and more obvious, and he hurriedly retreated. However, the Lord's Avatar's charging speed became faster and faster, and with the mechanical army around him restraining him, the distance between the two sides rapidly shortened. In the blink of an eye, there was only a small distance left.

Seeing the Lord's Avatar rapidly enlarging in his vision, thoughts flashed through Heart Tree King's mind one after another, and the thought of self-destruction immediately surfaced in his mind.

However, he had a lot of things to think about. He tried to figure out what Han Xiao meant, and in a hurry, he did not immediately make up his mind like the simple-minded Subduing Tree King.

However, it was during this moment of hesitation that the Sovereign's Avatar, which was wrapped in golden energy, crashed into him and leaped into his arms. His biochemical muscles instantly swelled.

Heart Tree King felt a strong force wrap around his body. Not only was he unable to move, but even the cells in his body were suppressed. He was shocked.

Was this … a Pugilist's forceful control technique?

"It hit!"

Han Xiao clenched his fists in excitement.

In order to complement this move, he had specially modified a batch of Lord's Avatar bodies that specialized in close combat over the past few months. They could withstand his Strength and Endurance attributes to the maximum, allowing [Azure Dragon Bind] to unleash even greater power!

Heart Tree King's Strength and Endurance were far inferior to a Pugilist's. After the forceful control, he would not be able to break free so quickly.

Just as Heart Tree King was hit, the surrounding mechanical troops were already prepared. They released force fields to envelop him and superimposed more control methods.

"Hella!"

Han Xiao shouted.

At this moment, a beam of light flashed through the mechanical army not far away from Heart Tree King. Hella's figure suddenly appeared beside an Apostle Weapon that was secretly carrying a Throne. The bright red 'Dead Sea' instantly spread out.

The next moment, Hella's body sank into the 'Dead Sea' and appeared beside Heart Tree King in the blink of an eye. She held the Spacetime Amber in her hand and pressed it toward Heart Tree King.

The Spacetime Amber flashed, and the frozen spacetime quickly expanded, enveloping the immobile Heart Tree King and the Lord's Avatar.

Heart Tree King's eyes widened, but he could not even speak.

His encounter was transmitted through the mental network. The surrounding fleets immediately turned their cannons and fired at him. The World Tree experts scattered everywhere were shocked. At the same time, they retreated and charged in the direction of the Heart Tree King.

"Sh * t!"

Fortitude Tree King's heart skipped a beat. He could not be bothered to deal with the enemy and turned around to support Heart Tree King. However, Herberlon shattered a large portion of the thrusters on his back.

Han Xiao had already consciously distanced himself from the battlefield, leaving Heart Tree King alone. No World Tree Beyond Grade As could arrive quickly.

Under the furious, shocked, and disbelieving gazes, a new Spacetime Amber Ball was formed, freezing Heart Tree King's shocked expression.

Hella stared at Heart Tree King, whose face was filled with shock, and a cold glint flashed in her eyes.

"Since you hurt my sister, you'll stay here forever!"

(End of Chapter)
